senses.gloss: ch. same, to move, run. Part. רָגֵיל.
units: Bekh. 11ᵃ, v. רִגְיָא.—Part. pass. רָגִיל used, q. v.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:5">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>דר׳ דזבן</he> who is wont to buy (fish for the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:5">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>אי רְגִילִיתוּ וכ׳</he> if you are accustomed to &c., v. <cite ref="S02088"><he>קְרַם</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to cause to run. Y. Ab. Zar. V, 45ᵃ אהו דמְרַגֵּל זיקא וכ׳ he that makes the jet of wine run from above downward.

units: <cite ref="Yevamot 85b:10">Yeb. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>היא מַרְגְּלָא ליה</he> she leads (persuades) him, v. preced.—Part. pass. <he>מַרְגַּל</he>; f. <cite ref="M02517"><he>מַרְגְּלָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M02517"><he>מַרְגְּלָא</he> I</cite>.

senses.gloss: to accustome one’s self, make it a habit.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 66b:3">Ned. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>כי היכי דלא לִתְרַגְּלֵי למנדר</he> (Rashi <he>לִירַגְּלֵי</he>) that they may not make it a habit to vow.
